facts.fact: ANACIM's head of forecasting says forecasters use near-real-time Meteosat Third Generation imagery to see fine-scale convective cloud features.
ANACIM's head of forecasting says MTG Lightning Imager data are critical during the rainy season for alerting communities to extreme weather.

AICCRA says ANACIM, the national meteorological agency, now generates crop-specific agro-climatic bulletins through the AgData Hub that combine near-real-time forecasts, satellite observations and seasonal outlooks.
